rule: Reuse the unique complete stock-raw and z3-legal-exhaustive baselines from the same suite/repetition/cache/seed at top-10. Baseline reuse requires identical raw/legal config universes. Run only z3-cm-topk, budget-raw, and budget-random for each additional budget.
reason: stock-raw and z3-legal-exhaustive do not depend on the guided top-k budget. Repeating them adds profiling cost without adding configurations or statistical independence.
accounting: Main top-10 includes the complete raw and legal-oracle cost once. Every sensitivity row records baseline_top_k=10 and baseline_shared_with_top10=true; oracle work is not described as free.

constraint_revision.validation: The first complete stock-raw run has 48 validation failures. The formula predicts exactly the same 48 configs with zero missing and zero unexpected failures. Guided top-10 is unchanged.
constraint_revision.first_batch_role: validation evidence preserved; later formal batches use the revised space

fallback: If a complete unique top-10 baseline is unavailable or its config universe differs, speedup, quality, and correlation fields are unavailable rather than inferred. A failed legal-oracle does not erase successful raw evidence: quality uses the full stock-raw optimum with quality_reference=stock-raw, and rank analysis uses only successful raw configs with legal_oracle_complete=false and an explicit denominator.
